name: Snowfall
description: Snow falling in three depths that settles into soft caps on any element marked as a ledge.

props.name: density
props.description: Multiplier for the number of flakes. Settling speeds up with it.

props.name: wind
props.description: How far the snow leans, from -1 (blowing left) to 1 (blowing right). It gusts a little around this value.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the fall, the sway and the settling.

props.name: accumulate
props.description: Let snow settle on descendants marked with `data-snow-ledge`. Each collects a cap along its top edge that follows its corner radius.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest a cap can grow, in pixels. Full caps stop growing and slowly settle.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Change it to melt every cap away.

props.name: ref
props.description: Call `clear()` to melt every cap away.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the snow. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content the snow falls behind, onto and in front of. The nearest flakes and the settled snow are drawn above it.
